text:
By Dave Jensen ,
7 hours ago
Fall in Colorado not only means the changing of the leaves and things getting cooler, it also means Halloween and Trick-Or-Treating events in the Fort Collins area.
How Far Does ‘Trick-Or-Treating’ Go Back in the USA? According to SmithsonianMag.com , though the premise of getting treats from strangers in exchange for not pulling some “stunt” goes back centuries ago to Europe, “Trick-Or-Treating” became coined in the U.S. in Michigan in the late 1920s. Over 100 years later, kids of all ages across America have fun getting costumed up and having fun.
TSM Media Center "There are a couple of “Trunk-Or-Treat” events on the 2025 list for Northern Colorad"
Being part of a Morale Team at one of my old jobs, I came up with a story on how “The British Created Halloween.” The story: The British were normally really uptight, drinking their tea and all, but for one night they’d be “Allowing” craziness to take place; the word “Allowing” into Halloween. It was kind of clever, if completely made up.
READ MORE: Northern Colorado Spirit Halloween Locations for 2025
Trick-Or-Treating has certainly changed over the decades; whereas we used to hit the neighborhood streets for candy and fun, today it’s more about community gatherings where kids can Trick-Or-Treat safely, with other kids. It makes it easier in a lot of ways, especially when it comes to the thought of drudging through the snowy neighborhood, as it’s bound to snow around Halloween.

Windsor's annual even begins with the Zombie Dash at 11:30 a.m. with the Trick-Or-Treating getting underway at 1:00 p.m. Food Trucks and inflatables will also be a part of the event. 14 Colorado-Themed Halloween Costumes Looking to show your Colorado pride while celebrating Halloween? We can help! Here are 14 costume ideas based on Colorado themes, people and, well, other "inspired" ideas.
Find the pieces pictured at thrift stores, Halloween costume stores or on that big online shop. Gallery Credit: Dave Jensen Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: A Subaru How about going as a Subaru with California license plates (for extra effect)? Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Rocky Mountain Oysters It was suggested going as ' Rocky Mountain Oysters .' Best way to pull that off is going as an angry bull. Pull together a sweatsuit and a few brown balloons, and voila. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Coors Beer Go as a can of Coors . We suggest getting a plain 'Beer' costume and then pasting some Coors 12-pack or case boxes to it! Yummy! Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Barrel Man The last great ' Barrel Ma n' from Denver Broncos fame. It'll take a little work, but you'll be a hit. Grab a garbage can and some suspenders. All you really need if you are adventurous. (Wink, wink.) Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: John Denver John Denver would be a great Colorado-themed costume. If you have one, you should bring your guitar, too. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: South Park Characters Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny, Butters. The South Park kids are always fun. Buy a ready-made Halloween costume or find the right jackets, new or used. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Shining Twins The twin girls from ' The Shining ' will give the other party-goers the chills. If you are twins, this is a 'must' costume. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Blucifer There's definitely something scary about Blucifer . Get a blue horse costume and slap on some red sunglasses, and you're good to go! Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Jake Jabs American Furniture Warehouse's president and CEO, Jake Jabs . A dress shirt, a white wig, and a stuffed lion: Perfection. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Dumb and Dumber Tried and True. Dumb & Dumber tuxedos. We're 'saying there's a chance' that folks will love you. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Mork from ... Grab those TV fans' attention by going as Mork from 'Mork & Mindy.' Rainbow suspenders are a must unless you want to try and emulate his 'space' outfit. Nanu-Nanu. (You do know the Boulder connection, right?) Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Craft Beer Coloradans love their Craft Beer , and they'll love YOU with this 'beer' costume. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: Killdozer This one is a 'tangent.' Remember ' Killdozer ' in Granby? Get yourself a blanket with bulldozers and a crazy mask. You'll get points for knowing about the incident and your ingenuity. Canva.com Colorado Costume Idea: The Stanley Cup Go, Avs! Celebrate Halloween and the championship-winning team by going as ' The Stanley Cup .' Get a Red Solo Cup costume, paint it with silver paint, and flip it over. Bring a hockey stick to help 'sell' the costume.
